tagline: A simple booking page for Nuni's cleaning business
painPoint: You said it yourself — the business grew past what pen and paper can track. This hands the tracking part to clients: they pick their own slot, it lands on your calendar, done.
demoSubtitle: Built for Nuni — clients pick a time that works for them, no more digging through the notebook.
features: Clients grab their own open slot online, no back-and-forth texting
Every booking lands in one place automatically, no more paper to lose track of
One-time cost, no monthly subscription stacked on top of everything else
You still confirm details and handle the job the same way you always have
